name: DiagTrack
purpose: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry: collects and uploads diagnostic data.
sideEffects: Diagnostic/feedback features stop; Windows security and updates are unaffected.

name: MapsBroker
purpose: Downloaded Maps Manager: updates offline maps.
sideEffects: Offline maps update only when the Maps app runs.

name: TrkWks
purpose: Distributed Link Tracking Client: repairs links to files moved between NTFS volumes.
sideEffects: Shortcuts to moved network files may not auto-repair.

name: PcaSvc
purpose: Program Compatibility Assistant: detects known compatibility issues in older programs.
sideEffects: No automatic compatibility prompts for old programs.

name: WSearch
purpose: Windows Search: indexes files, email and other content.
sideEffects: Start, Explorer and Outlook search become slow and incomplete.

name: SysMain
purpose: SysMain (Superfetch): preloads frequently used apps and manages memory heuristics.
sideEffects: App launches may be slower; beneficial on HDD systems — Microsoft recommends leaving it on.

name: Fax
sideEffects: Windows Fax and Scan cannot fax.

name: RetailDemo
purpose: Retail demo mode for store display PCs.
sideEffects: None for home PCs.

name: WMPNetworkSvc
sideEffects: Media library sharing to other devices stops.

name: wisvc
sideEffects: Required only for the Windows Insider Program.

name: RemoteRegistry
purpose: Allows remote users to modify the registry.
sideEffects: Remote administration tools that need it stop working (security improvement when disabled).

name: RemoteAccess
sideEffects: Routing/VPN server features stop. Disabled by default on client Windows.

name: lfsvc
purpose: Geolocation Service: provides location to apps.
sideEffects: Location-aware apps, Find my device and automatic time zone stop working.

name: PhoneSvc
sideEffects: Phone Link calls may stop working.

name: SharedAccess
sideEffects: Mobile hotspot and ICS stop working.

name: XblAuthManager
sideEffects: Game Pass / Xbox-integrated games cannot sign in.

name: XblGameSave
sideEffects: Cloud saves of Xbox/Game Pass games stop syncing.

name: XboxNetApiSvc
purpose: Xbox Live networking (party chat, multiplayer NAT).
sideEffects: Xbox multiplayer/party features break.

name: XboxGipSvc
purpose: Xbox accessory management (controllers via USB/wireless adapter).
sideEffects: Xbox controller firmware updates and some accessories stop working.

name: GamingServices
purpose: Gaming Services for Microsoft Store / Game Pass games.
sideEffects: Game Pass games will not launch.

name: Spooler
purpose: Print Spooler: required for printing and 'Print to PDF'.
sideEffects: All printing, including Print to PDF, stops.

name: WbioSrvc
sideEffects: Windows Hello fingerprint/face sign-in stops working.

name: bthserv
sideEffects: Bluetooth controllers, headsets and mice stop working.

name: BTAGService
sideEffects: Bluetooth headset microphones stop working.

name: SensorService
purpose: Sensor Service (orientation, light sensors on laptops/tablets).
sideEffects: Auto-rotation and adaptive brightness stop.

name: SensrSvc
sideEffects: Adaptive brightness may stop.

name: SCardSvr
sideEffects: Smart card readers stop working.

name: stisvc
sideEffects: Scanners stop working.

name: FrameServer
sideEffects: Webcams may stop working in apps.

name: NVDisplay.ContainerLocalSystem
purpose: NVIDIA Display Container: required for NVIDIA Control Panel and driver features.
sideEffects: NVIDIA Control Panel and some driver features stop working.

name: AMD External Events Utility
purpose: AMD driver helper for FreeSync and display events.
sideEffects: FreeSync and some AMD driver features may stop working.

name: WerSvc
sideEffects: Crash reports are not processed; troubleshooting becomes harder.

name: DPS
purpose: Diagnostic Policy Service: problem detection and troubleshooting.
sideEffects: Troubleshooters and resource diagnostics stop working.

name: Wecsvc
sideEffects: None on home PCs.

name: WpcMonSvc
sideEffects: Microsoft Family Safety limits stop working.

name: icssvc
sideEffects: Mobile hotspot stops working.

name: SEMgrSvc
sideEffects: NFC payments stop working.

name: AJRouter
sideEffects: Legacy AllJoyn IoT devices stop working.
